observations: Photo 0 shows an orange LPG gas cylinder with a protective wire mesh cage around it.
The cylinder has a top valve/regulator area with a small brass-colored valve fitting visible.
Photo 1 is a close-up of the top/valve area; the mesh cage is visible around the lower body.
No brand name, cylinder stamp, serial number, or capacity marking is clearly readable in the photos.

claims.evidence: The photos do not show any readable capacity marking (e.g., 12kg) or cylinder stamp/label.

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity may not be 12kg (could be different size).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity marking (e.g., '12kg') and serial/inspection details on the body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed capacity (worst-case for value: treat as a smaller/unknown cylinder).

risks.risk: Valve/regulator compatibility and leak status are unknown (could be leaking or damaged).
risks.proof: Video of a full leak test (soap-bubble test) at the valve/regulator connection, plus a close-up of the valve condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially leaking/damaged (worst-case: assume it needs repair or cannot be used).

risks.risk: Cylinder condition/age and safety inspection status are unknown (could be expired or dented).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the cylinder stamp/inspection date and any dents, rust, or impact marks on the body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unsafe/expired until proven (worst-case: reduced value).

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or not filled; seller’s 'foreign' claim doesn’t confirm fill level.
risks.proof: Photo/video showing the cylinder weight/scale reading or a receipt/indicator of fill level (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as empty/unknown fill (worst-case: lower value).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder stamp/label showing capacity (12kg) and inspection/serial details.
Video of soap-bubble leak test at the valve/regulator connection (and show the valve threads/condition).
Photos of the full cylinder body for dents, heavy rust, or impact damage.
If the cylinder is filled: proof of fill level (weight on a scale or any fill receipt/indicator).
response.reason: From the photos, it’s clearly an LPG cylinder with a protective mesh cage, but the key pricing driver—confirming it is a 12kg foreign cylinder and that it’s safe/usable (capacity, inspection status, leak-free valve)—is not readable or verifiable. Request the stamped capacity/inspection photo and a leak-test clip before pricing.
